## Nep6AccountSigner Class

Signs Meshline account input with a Neo N3 single\-signature account from a NEP\-6 wallet\.

```csharp
public sealed class Nep6AccountSigner : Meshline.Interactions.IAccountSigner, System.IDisposable
```

Inheritance [System\.Object](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.object 'System\.Object') → Nep6AccountSigner

Implements [IAccountSigner](Meshline.Interactions.IAccountSigner.md 'Meshline\.Interactions\.IAccountSigner'), [System\.IDisposable](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.idisposable 'System\.IDisposable')

### Remarks
The caller owns this signer and must dispose it\. Loading never changes the wallet or registers DI services\.
